messages:
alex: Deployed v3.5.0 to prod at 2024-11-12T12:10Z in the change window. Canary->prod for embeds. Anyone on-call?
qa_raj: Error rate on /v1/embeds jumped to ~18% in usw2, OOMs on embed-worker-3.
sre_tom: deploy-bot flagged autorevert rule: error_rate>5% for 3m. Conditions tripped.
deploy-bot: (bot) Autorevert suggestion: revert -> v3.4.2; reason=embed OOMs; confidence=0.92. Manual approval required.
maria: Leaning manual rollback during the quiet window. Hotfix risks kernel regressions.
alex: Manual rollback approved. Ops to execute; DevEx to draft customer note.
ops_lin: On call. Plan: pin to v3.4.2, shift traffic to stable pool. Runbook: `deploy rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope=usw2 --graceful`; monitor p95 + error_rate 10m.
devex_julie: I'll draft status page blurb and PR for release notes.
maria: Also pin embeddings model to quantized build to reduce memory.
ops_lin: Executing rollback now. `> deploy rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope=usw2 --graceful`
ops_lin: Draining canary, shifting traffic. ETA ~3m.
qa_raj: Errors falling; p95 improving in last minute. :thumbsup: 
alex: Once stable, post to #cust-notify and link incident.
devex_julie: Draft: "Rolled back v3.5.0 -> v3.4.2 due to elevated embed errors; active investigation. Customers on embedding routes may have seen errors between 12:10-12:16 UTC."
maria: Action: repro under load, inspect KV cache and memory alloc, tag infra for kernel checks.
sre_tom: Opening incident INC-2024-1125, assigning infra, attaching logs/metrics.
ops_lin: Will update status page and mark change window complete after confirmation.
alex: Thanks team. Add rollback timeline + learnings to incident (canary thresholds, kvcache limits). Closing once notes posted.
